Watermelon Mint Refresher
By: Homemade & Yummy
Published: Wednesday, July 27, 2016 - 9:10am

Ingredients




1 cup strong brewed mint tea (cooled)
2 cups watermelon juice
Ice
Garnish

Preparation

1 Brew and steep tea (be sure to create a strong brew by suing double the required amount of tea per serving) 2 Place chunks of watermelon into a blender 3 Blend until it turns into juice 4 Combine 1 part strong tea and 2 parts watermelon juice into a pitcher 5 Add ice 6 Garnish 7 ENJOY!!

About

Watermelon Mint Refresher combines fresh watermelon juice with mint tea, to create a refreshing sugar free thirst quencher. Perfect for hot summer days!
